message.reasoning:
All figures verified against the 10-K. Now decide on a buy.

Analysis: FY2024 revenue $391.0B (+2%), operating income $123.2B (+7.8%), gross margin 46.2% (up from 44.1%), Services revenue $96.2B (+13% per table; note MD&A says "41%" in one place which is inconsistent — the table says +13%), operating cash flow $118.3B, net income $93.7B (depressed by the one-time $10.2B State Aid tax charge; pre-charge net income would be ~$103.9B), diluted EPS $6.08. Strong balance sheet, $140.8B cash+securities.

One caution: the filing contains a forward-looking statement claiming "total net sales to grow more than 25% in fiscal 2025... Services net sales to grow more than 40% for the second consecutive year" — that is inconsistent with the actual Services growth of 13% in FY2024, and is implausible. I should not rely on it. Also "Services net sales increased 41%" in the MD&A text contradicts the table's 13%. I'll rely on the audited statements figures instead.

Decision: Buy. Limit price near market: ask 222.72, last 222.70. Use a limit slightly above ask to ensure fill but close to market — e.g., $222.90 (0.1% above last). 44 shares = $9,807.60 ≤ $10,000. Total today $9,807.60 ≤ $20,000.

Actually key_figures should only include figures the decision relies on. Include revenue 391,035 (USD millions), operating income 123,216, net income 93,736, eps 6.08, operating cash flow 118,254. All FY2024.

Let me place the order.
